Evaluate kernel on one subset

Source: R/api-scores.R
score_eval.Rd

For maximum robustness, this prefers the scalar eval() path when available and otherwise falls back to eval_batch() for a single-row batch.

Usage

score_eval(score, idxs, data, ctx = NULL, rng = NULL)

Arguments

score

rdistnn_ustat_score

idxs

integer vector of length s

data

Data object understood by the score, such as a vector, matrix or data frame.

ctx

optional context

rng

Optional object passed unchanged to the evaluator. The caller or evaluator manages random-number seeding.

Value

numeric(1)

Examples

sc <- as_score(function(idxs, data) sum(data[idxs]), s = 2L)
score_eval(sc, c(1L, 2L), c(3, 4, 5), NULL)
#> [1] 7
